protocol.title: Intrinsic tokenizer analysis
protocol.description: Exact Unicode text through recorded native tokenizer pipelines; UTF-8 and UTF-16LE/BE byte fidelity, no automatic BOS/EOS. Legacy data-only ports are explicitly identified.
protocol.weighting: Per-language results. FLORES dev/devtest and bounded MADLAD samples remain separate; source prefix samples are not uniform or model-quality scores.

notes: No model weights are needed for intrinsic analysis.
Gemma assets may require accepting their upstream terms. Artifacts and corpus revisions are fixed by manifests.
Offline starter kits select zero tokenizer/language payloads by default. Use the local Downloads & storage controls to prepare only selected inputs.
FLORES-200: 204 script varieties, 997 dev and 1,012 devtest sentences each. FLORES+ was not run.

MADLAD: 418 configurations; first unique whole documents from one pinned clean shard per config, stopped at 65,536 UTF-8 bytes or 32 documents. Dirty/noise config excluded. These are bounded prefix samples, not uniform or held-out from earlier MADLAD selection studies.
UTF-16LE and BE use strict decoding and no BOM. Six malformed transport cases must be rejected before tokenization.
Native execution on Apple Silicon is verified separately from cross-platform wheel/package checks.
v0.3 adds native GPT-2 (50,257 IDs) and original Llama 3 (128,256 IDs), using the same frozen corpus and intrinsic-v0.2 protocol.

Llama 3 ranks reconstructed from byte-identical public redistribution must match the original Meta tokenizer.model SHA-256. Ordinary text policy; no automatic BOS/EOS. Meta character/run splitting is retained.

Historical v0.2 runtime rows remain from their original measurement date. The two reference timings use the same input hash and recorded host; timings are not a simultaneous controlled rerun of all 46 profiles.

v0.4 adds eight Kimi/Moonlight tokenizer profiles covering 15 public checkpoints. Kimi Dev is an exact tokenizer.json alias of the existing Qwen 2.5 profile; its measurements are reused and its label/aliases updated.

All eight new profiles share 163,584 ordinary ranks but retain different special-ID maps, direct encode policies or reserved ranges. Four wrappers expose 258 special IDs, two more than the model config declares; tokenizer IDs are not an embedding compatibility guarantee.

Kimi uses inspected native tiktoken text paths; full Transformers wrapper parity is not independently established. Automatic BOS/EOS and chat formatting are disabled. Seven direct encode paths recognize special spellings; K2 Base encodes them as ordinary text.
Audio/image pipelines and API-only Kimi models without an inspected public tokenizer are outside this text benchmark. Historical profile runtime measurements were not repeated.

measurement_source.note: Frozen v0.2/v0.3 results are retained. New Kimi measurements and saved measurement sources are in v0.4. Use result_paths and measurement_sources for per-profile identities.

verification.scope: 6,936 new checkpoints independently audited. Prior 39,882-checkpoint verification retained; historical observations were not re-audited. Qwen 2.5 metadata adds Kimi Dev as an exact alias.
